messages:
Jordan: Quick office weather update 0C in the kitchen again. If youre wearing shorts please start a support group. :thermometer: /sweater emoji encouraged.
Lina: officially switching my desk to Hot Desk B (by the window). sun + laptop = morale. :sun_with_face:
Diego: GIF of a penguin in sunglasses (link)
Kelsey: tiny game: post your best three-word work survival line. winner gets bragging rights + a mystery snack.
Jordan: "Sip. Repeat. Ship."
Lina: "Layer, then conquer."
Diego: "Pretend I know."
Kelsey: "Mute, then unmute."
SnackBot: :package: New snack drop in kitchen: lemon cookies and sea-salt chips. First come, first served.
Jordan: also a very important poll: React with :thumbsup: for keep it cool, :thumbsdown: for crank the heat, :thermometer: for open-window compromise.
Lina: voted :thumbsup: (cold but fashionable).
Diego: voted :thermometer: (I like drama).
Kelsey: voted :thumbsdown: (parka season).
Jordan: tally: 1 cool / 1 compromise / 1 heat. democracy is noisy.
Lina: bonus one-liner from Diego: "Coffee is protocol." :coffee:
Jordan: official note: please label any food (name + date) and if you're taking snacks, leave a friendly note for the person who stocked them. tiny kindnesses = better Mondays.
Kelsey: agreed. also asking the gods of thermostat to be merciful. :pray:
Diego: random pledge: I will not reheat fish in the microwave at lunch on Thursdays.
Lina: heroic. thank you.
Jordan: closing remarks: three-word winners (subjective): "Sip. Repeat. Ship." and "Layer, then conquer." both ascend to legend status. happy warm/cold indecision day everyone :confetti_ball:
